channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Alzheimer’s Foundation of America to host free education conference in Houston
item.description: The foundation will hold a free conference on Feb. 11, highlighting discussions with experts on Alzheimer’s disease, brain health and caregiving.

item.title: Houston-area Alamo Drafthouse among those shuttered as part of statewide cinema closings
item.description: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema started in Austin in 1997 and made a name for itself by serving dinner and drinks during movie screenings, a service that has become widespread in theaters.

item.title: Denied abortion for a doomed pregnancy, she tells Texas court: ‘There was no mercy’
item.description: Women who had complicated and tragic pregnancies are suing Texas over its abortion bans. A hearing had emotional testimony in an Austin courtroom Wednesday. The state wants the case dismissed.

item.title: Free COVID tests by mail are back, starting this week
item.description: People will be able to go to COVIDTests.gov and get four free tests per household, starting Monday. The Biden administration says it is trying to prepare for the fall and winter COVID season.

item.title: Public Utility Commission of Texas to study water usage at data centers as they expand across state
item.description: The commission will share its findings with the Texas Water Development Board and Texas Commission on Environmental Quality.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 9, 2026)
item.description: Today: We talk with NAACP Houston president Bishop James Dixon II, Texas Lieutenant Governor candidate Marcos Velez discusses his campaign, and we receive a live report from the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy.

item.title: Meet the Texas Democrats vying to challenge Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick in November
item.description: Three Democrats want to bring new ideas to the role of Lieutenant Governor of Texas. But no matter who wins March's Democratic primary, they'll face an uphill battle running against incumbent Republican Dan Patrick in November.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 9, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters – we have “The Commuter Cut” – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Historic Galveston ship will sail to New York for nation’s 250th anniversary
item.description: The voyage for the 1877 Elissa is part of Sail250, a global gathering of tall ships and military ships to celebrate the United States' 250th Anniversary.

item.title: Meet the left-leaning candidates in the Houston City Council special election for District C
item.description: Seven candidates will appear on the ballot April 4, when voters in some parts of Houston will select a successor to Abbie Kamin.
